clues: This large city sits in the north of India. It is the main city of the state of Uttarakhand.
Hot summers give way to cool winters here. In the wet season, monsoon rain pours down in large amounts.
In the early 1800s Gorkha rulers took this city. When the Anglo-Gorkha War ended, it passed to British hands.
This place has served as state capital since the year 2000. In 2020, Gairsain was named the summer capital.
Picture a valley at the foot of the Himalayas. A lower range, the Shivalik Range, lies just to the south.
